ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in diagonal bands and 60% low-intensity black pixels across the median and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two prominent contiguous high-intensity bands originating near the peduncle and extending diagonally toward the distal tips. These bands are bordered by solid low-intensity black regions at the center and trailing edge. High-frequency mottling is visible at the transition boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 1/6th of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical trailing edge with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks/valleys) on the left lobe and more pronounced, deeper indentations on the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the outer leading edges, terminating in sharp upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast yellowish-white pixel clusters at the far-right distal tip; small, discrete white circular spots visible within the black pigmentation of the left lobe's trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible across the high-intensity white band on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular, textured protrusion/scarring at the right fluke tip with distinct yellowish-tan pixel values. Several small notches on the right lobe's trailing edge indicate physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique yellowish-brown chromatic anomaly at the distal end of the right fluke, contrasting with the standard black/white ventral pigmentation.
